description: Fantasy football trade-value rankings for a league format (dynasty or redraft, Superflex or 1QB), for all positions or one of QB, RB, WR, TE. Returns rank, value and one-week change, 25 players at a time by default.

league.description: League settings. Omit for the default: 12-team dynasty Superflex, full PPR, 1 QB / 2 RB / 3 WR / 1 TE / 1 Flex (+1 Superflex)

format.description: dynasty (keeper, multi-year value) or redraft (rest of this season only)

ppr.description: Points per reception: 1 full PPR, 0.5 half, 0 standard

superflex.description: True if teams can start a second quarterback (Superflex or 2QB). Default: true for dynasty, false for redraft

te_premium.description: Extra points per tight end reception

offset.description: Skip this many from the top (for the next page)

position.description: Only this position. Omit for all positions

name: get_rankings
title: Get fantasy football rankings
